name: Integrity abstraction seam (property-profile, fail-closed, deny-by-default)

stack.model: sparq sec-prop / sig-impl / sec-req structure; @jeswr placeholder IRIs (ALIGNMENT.md)
stack.build: tsc (committed dist/, check:dist gate); rdf-canonize + n3 stay external npm deps

notes: The integrity abstraction from the integrity-first design (§A/§C.1, maintainer-signed-off 2026-07-06). 'Integrity' is the top-level concept — certainty that data meets a STATED integrity requirement — with Verifiable Credentials demoted from 'the layer' to one mechanism (as HTTP is one transport). Property-PROFILE model (NOT an ordinal enum): 6 base + 8 advanced integrity properties, {yes|partial|no} verdicts mirroring sparq sig-impl assertions, named IL0-IL4 profiles + orthogonal add-on flags. Fail-closed satisfies() (absent property => no) and deny-by-default verifyIntegrity() over an injectable provider registry (issuer-agnostic-verifier shaped; a throwing/hostile provider can never yield acceptance). Ships the §A.4 mechanism->property assertion table as data, and ONE built-in provider behind ./rdfc: a trusted-reference RDFC-1.0 content-hash verifier (IL2) hardened against poison-graph DoS (byte/quad/blank-node caps + rdf-canonize maxWorkFactor + timeout). LOAD-BEARING RULE: @jeswr/integrity NEVER imports @jeswr/solid-vc — the solid-vc ./integrity provider depends on THIS package, not the reverse. Consumed by the personal-agent mandate verifier, solid-vc, codegen signed-manifest, and concept-hash designs. Opus-authored (security-critical).
